title: 3in1 Double Barrel Glass VapCap Stem
description:
3in1 Double Barrel
Take that dynavap experience to another level. This glass stem allows the use of 2 dynavap tips at once. The double barrel will connect to most 10mm, 14mm and 18mm female joints.
Dynavap Tips NOT Included
Included
1 X 3in1 Double Barrel Glass VapCap Stem
